$comment: The paths that define the guardrails (`chock check --floor`, floor/control-plane-changed). Matched with fnmatch after case folding, so `*` crosses `/`; a symlink or gitlink at a parent folder of a pattern matches too, and a symlinked control-plane folder's in-repo target is control plane. A pull request that adds, changes, deletes or re-modes one is listed; the base's `.chock/config.yaml` decides refuse or listed. Whole folder for every agent chock or agentseam writes into (hooks, permissions, MCP, plugins, skills, subagents), plus the engine's CI workflow and store files; tests/test_floor_control_plane_list.py checks the list against the engine's own data. Instruction files at the root (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are left out: they steer an agent, they are not guardrails. What chock knows about, not a proof of completeness.
